projects.subtitle: Systems shipped to production, combining strict software structure with an uncompromised user experience.

items.title: Dental Clinic Management SaaS
items.description: A complete SaaS platform for dental practice management: online booking, digital patient records and automated billing, designed to make dentists' work easier.
items.focus: Practitioner-friendly UX, high data security, strong performance.
items.context: Centralising appointments, patient records and billing for a dental practice in a single tool, accessible from any browser.
items.challenge: Reconciling ultra-fast data entry in the practice with strict health-data isolation and billing integrity.

items.title: Papernote
items.description: An AI-powered SaaS tool for accelerated review, comparative analysis and synthesis of complex academic publications and theses.
items.focus: AI integration, fast complex document processing, clean interface.
items.context: Reading and summarising scientific papers faster: summary, detailed analysis and scoring in a single pass.
items.role: Design, full-stack development and launch, AI model integration.
items.challenge: Analysing and summarising academic documents of several hundred pages accurately, within short response times.

items.title: Delyx Delivery
items.description: A motorbike delivery platform across Algeria: customers describe their errand, pick their courier, follow the route live by geolocation and pay cash on arrival.
items.focus: Courier choice and favourites, real-time tracking, upfront pricing, verified identities.
items.context: Running a motorbike delivery end to end: matching customers with couriers, live ride tracking and cash payment, with accounts and favourites.
items.challenge: Coordinating urban fleets end to end with continuous geolocation, instant fare calculation and secure identity verification.

items.title: Tiberium Consulting
items.description: A consulting web app with real-time messaging and a premium exchange interface between expert firms and their clients.
items.context: Connecting consultants and clients through a messaging space with real-time chat, instead of emails and phone calls.
items.role: Design, full-stack development and launch, real-time features.
items.challenge: Delivering latency-free real-time messaging inside a decoupled architecture, with secure transfer of confidential deliverables.

faq.title: Answers to the most frequent questions.
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting the design of your website or application.

items.question: How long does it take to build a professional website?
items.answer: It depends on the functional scope: a showcase website is usually designed and shipped in 2 to 4 weeks, while a custom web app or SaaS needs more iteration cycles (often 6 to 10 weeks). The exact schedule is agreed when we start, before the first line of code.

items.question: How does a project run?
items.answer: Four phases: scoping, design and architecture, sprint-based development, then production launch. You validate each key step before moving to the next, with one defined deliverable per phase.

items.question: How do I get a quote and what does it cost to start?
items.answer: The quote is completely free and non-binding. Describe your project through the form or directly on WhatsApp: I get back to you within 24 business hours to scope the need, then send a transparent priced proposal (scope, schedule, validation steps). No payment is requested before your formal approval.

items.question: Do you provide support and maintenance after delivery?
items.answer: Yes: a 30-day warranty support is included after every delivery. Beyond that, preventive maintenance plans (security updates, off-site backups, regular minor adjustments) are available to keep your tool long-lived.

items.question: Who owns the domain name, the hosting and the source code?
items.answer: You remain 100% owner. The domain name and the hosting infrastructure are registered in your name, and at final delivery the full source code is handed over to you without restrictive clauses. You are never locked in.

items.question: I have no finalised copy or visuals, is that an obstacle?
items.answer: Not at all. I guide you in structuring your key messaging, defining the logical order of the pages and selecting coherent professional visuals. The content is worked out with you from the initial mockup stage.
